meta.title: Cart total: the discount was counted twice
meta.subtitle: The fix changes 1 line and adds 1 comment line. Look at the 3 pictures, then the green lines.

bigPicture.title: The total was too low
bigPicture.text: A 10 dollar shirt with a 2 dollar discount showed 6 dollars, not 8.
bigPicture.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 260 190' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='4' y='4' width='252' height='182' rx='12' fill='#fff' stroke='#cfd6e4' stroke-width='2'/><text x='20' y='34' font-size='14' font-weight='700' fill='#1d2433'>Cart</text><text x='20' y='70' font-size='12' fill='#1d2433'>Shirt</text><text x='200' y='70' font-size='12' fill='#1d2433'>$10</text><text x='20' y='96' font-size='12' fill='#1d2433'>Discount</text><text x='200' y='96' font-size='12' fill='#1d2433'>-$2</text><line x1='20' y1='112' x2='240' y2='112' stroke='#cfd6e4'/><text x='20' y='140' font-size='13' font-weight='700' fill='#1d2433'>Total</text><text x='196' y='140' font-size='13' font-weight='700' fill='#e5484d'>$6</text><circle cx='206' cy='136' r='18' fill='none' stroke='#e5484d' stroke-width='3'/></svg>

bigPicture.title: The discount ran two times
bigPicture.text: The price already had the discount, then the total took it off again.
bigPicture.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 260 190' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='4' y='4' width='252' height='182' rx='12' fill='#f7f8fb' stroke='#cfd6e4' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='20' y='70' width='60' height='40' rx='8' fill='#d9f0fb'/><text x='34' y='95' font-size='12'>$10</text><rect x='100' y='70' width='60' height='40' rx='8' fill='#ffe3e3'/><text x='112' y='95' font-size='12'>-$2</text><rect x='180' y='70' width='60' height='40' rx='8' fill='#ffe3e3'/><text x='192' y='95' font-size='12'>-$2</text><text x='100' y='140' font-size='12' font-weight='700' fill='#e5484d'>twice</text></svg>

bigPicture.title: The fix
bigPicture.text: The total now starts from the full price, so the discount runs once.
bigPicture.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 260 190' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='4' y='4' width='252' height='182' rx='12' fill='#fff' stroke='#cfd6e4' stroke-width='2'/><rect x='30' y='70' width='70' height='40' rx='8' fill='#d9f0fb'/><text x='48' y='95' font-size='12'>$10</text><rect x='120' y='70' width='60' height='40' rx='8' fill='#ffe3e3'/><text x='132' y='95' font-size='12'>-$2</text><text x='196' y='96' font-size='14' font-weight='700' fill='#1f9d55'>= $8</text></svg>

removed.text: const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.salePrice * item.qty, 0);

notes.title: Start from the full price
notes.body: `item.price` is the price before any discount. The old line used `salePrice`, which already had the discount inside.

notes.title: A comment for the next person
notes.body: Says in plain words why the full price is used, so nobody changes it back.

notes.title: Discount taken off once
notes.body: This line did not change. It is now the only place the discount is used.

notes.title: Never below zero
notes.body: If a discount is bigger than the cart, the total shows 0, not a negative number.

checks.label: Every caller passes the full price
checks.detail: Searched for cartTotal: 2 callers, both pass items with price.

checks.label: Old saved carts
checks.detail: Not checked: carts saved before this fix may still store salePrice only.

glossary.meaning: Adds up every item in a list.
